text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2024

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi dua puluh tujuh juta

satu ratus tujuh puluh sembilan ribu ringgit (RM27,179,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Skim Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2024 adalah dengan ini

dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 3,794,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 17,033,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 501,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,388,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 4,463,000

JUMLAH 27,179,000

Dibuat 7 Februari 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(12); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2024

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding twenty-seven million

one hundred and seventy-nine thousand ringgit (RM27,179,000) from

the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for the expenditure on administration

of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme for the year 2024 is hereby

authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 3,794,000

Supplies and services 17,033,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 501,000

Other expenditures 1,388,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 4,463,000

TOTAL 27,179,000

Made 7 February 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(12); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

 Minister of Human Resources
